# Brigo

> Brigo is an AI study app for college and professional-exam students. It predicts likely exam questions from your course materials, generates spaced-repetition flashcards, converts notes into audio podcasts, and includes a 24/7 AI tutor. Available on iOS; Android coming soon.

Brigo was built by solo developer Francis Chukwuma in January 2026, originally to help his nursing-student girlfriend Bridget prepare for the NCLEX. The app applies pattern recognition to past exams and course syllabi to surface high-probability questions, and uses dual coding and retrieval-practice methods from cognitive science to improve long-term retention.

## About

- Type: Mobile application (iOS)
- Category: Education / EdTech / Study tools
- Audience: College and university students — nursing (NCLEX), pre-med (MCAT), engineering, and general exam prep
- Platform: iOS (iPhone, iPad). Android coming soon.
- Pricing: Free download; in-app subscription managed via Apple App Store
- Founder: Francis Chukwuma
- Launched: January 2026
- Last Updated: 2026-04-12

## Core features

- [Exam Predictor](https://brigo.app): Predicts likely exam questions from uploaded course materials and past exams
- [Notes to Podcasts](https://brigo.app): Converts lecture notes, PDFs, or YouTube links into audio summaries
- [Smart Flashcards](https://brigo.app): Auto-generates spaced-repetition flashcards from study materials
- [Adaptive Quizzes](https://brigo.app): Practice tests that adjust difficulty based on knowledge gaps
- [24/7 AI Tutor](https://brigo.app): On-demand explanations and step-by-step problem walkthroughs

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://brigo.app): Product overview and iOS download
- [The Science of Brigo](https://brigo.app/science): Research basis — dual coding (Paivio), cognitive load (Sweller), retrieval practice (Roediger)
- [Blog](https://brigo.app/blog): Study guides and exam-prep articles
- [Support](https://brigo.app/support): Product help, troubleshooting, billing
